detail.longDescription: I've been using Notion to take notes and organize my life for a few years now. As you might expect with a popular app like Notion, there are quite a few alternatives these days. Superhuman Docs (formerly known as Coda) might be the clearest 1:1 substitute for Notion if you're looking to try something new. I compared Notion against Coda for a prior version of this article.
